analysis_objectives.analysis_1_timecap_vs_early_exit: Frozen E0-accepted time-cap censored vs early STOP/TARGET baseline strata, tracing 12-18h and 18-24h incremental favorable/adverse path, funding cash, fee changes, exit reason fates, MFE/MAE, risk-scaled returns, and actual timestamps.
analysis_objectives.analysis_2_whole_account_opportunity_cos: Whole-account opportunity cost: independent E0/H1/H2 signal stream replays, logging signals declined due to prior position extension, exit ACK/cooldown, 5% cash reserve, 1x notional, cumulative cash, and minute Mark MTM. Distinguish matched same-event vs different account event set estimands.
analysis_objectives.analysis_3_time_execution_decomposition: Post-12h incremental signed price PnL vs extra settled Funding vs fees/spread/slip, additional Mark drawdown/occupancy, 2021/2022/2023 attribution, and one-bar later exit ACK / worse slip fixed sensitivities under BASE and STRESS.

falsification_gates.gate_1_h18_continuation_coin_flip: If >=45% of 12-18h time-cap continuation outcomes are adverse/reversals, the positive H1-E0 mean is an asymmetric right-tail outlier effect rather than a reliable continuation alpha.
falsification_gates.gate_2_h24_momentum_exhaustion: If 18-24h yields net negative mean continuation and increased stopouts, H2 underperformance relative to H1 is falsified as structural trend decay.
falsification_gates.gate_3_2023_instability: If W2 remains negative in 2023 under STRESS despite H1 extension, 18h holding cannot be claimed to rescue structural regime failure.
falsification_gates.gate_4_regime_targeting_feasibility: If as-of regime strata have N < 10 events, regime targeting is marked UNDERPOWERED and cannot support any selectable conditional exit policy.
falsification_gates.gate_5_opportunity_blocking: If extending horizon from 12h to 18h or 24h does not block new entries from the candidate stream (due to signal sparsity), account-level trade set equals the paired trade set, but capital occupancy increases.
